preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.

exploit_hint: The contract owner can call the `setMaxTxPercent` function with `maxTxPercent` set to 0. This action calculates `_maxTxAmount` as 0. Consequently, the `_transfer` function, which requires the transfer amount to be less than or equal to `_maxTxAmount`, will fail for any transfer amount greater than zero, effectively freezing the funds of all non-owner users.
